bat-adjustments.note: ADJ > BAT, stepped with Start, runs 44-52 and wraps from 52 NOVICE GAME AVAILABLE to 44; the manual's printer adjustments 52-54 are absent. No 37-44 transition. Raw scenario SHA256 757d422a2b9e6b7b16bf3941373a520fa13a313c817e04b63f41561010fed6a2; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 1cdbbdffbb190fbda690d9884e6cd19b795061257d357d52fa1a1e1f4eb189d1.

coil-test.note: COIL TEST: + shows the next entry with its wiring and RUN fires it; each entry fired only its own public address (the 1R-8R entries switch relay 10 first). #6L: NOT USED offers no RUN. RUN on #13: NOT USED holds public 13 on until the selection leaves RUN. Relay 10 has no entry of its own. Raw scenario SHA256 67673dbc9fd126eee285c36273096c5dac692315aa8f7b3a5a2f66491bcb4136; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 5c13f70aaa5798d11eebf6f47ac118d1abd89227bb58f3bc7f90fd5955257ce4.

cycling-coils.note: CYCLING COILS walks 1-9 with each muxed 25-32 behind relay 10, then 11-22, and also pulses 6 and holds 13 although its display names both NOT USED. Neither 6 nor 13 published state in any gameplay or attract run. Raw scenario SHA256 9c2e3e6dab63f1ccb5b1fea4105c3587a516ab52c1023bc46b5b293c034f7613; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 e0cc486bf662159d1358d78fc36e019303285ac1fcfba8e1ee55dda3c80e3dd2.

named_action_observations.label: left-button: paired states asserted and released together
right-button: paired states asserted and released together

gameplay.note: Fresh four-ball trough, cannon at home. Same-run checkpoints: lockout serve, up-kick, gun-trigger skill-shot launch, top eject, bumpers, slings, Laser Kick, C-A-V-E bank reset on the fourth target, VUK, lock at 62 answered by a replacement serve (with an automatic launch of that ball), Batcave exit kicker, cannon load starting motor relay 14 after about 2 s, and the gun trigger firing cannon 15. Both cabinet buttons assert and release their paired synthetic states. Raw scenario SHA256 fcf820617f49d83c04934b9b8dadb6f3b7495fab77e8277a505f3d0242218a5e; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 86ddf954f01921cc27757f7efcaf88a628915e6124c327a37226096421269422.

lamp-test.note: SINGLE LAMP TEST: each Start press lit exactly the stepped lamp 1-64. Frames at steps 1 and 21 show the display board's power-up version screen instead of the test, so those two readings come from lamp-test-2. Raw scenario SHA256 e67ffc75955f5f2f083114897e9d23d88cac3bd30773697457736c72d6c688d6; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 18bba44c8e0201ee795556406cc28bda5786bc8e1b720a3a6bb054717f7601c4.

lamp-test-2.note: Same scenario re-run in a new state directory; cited only for lamps 1 and 21. Raw scenario SHA256 e67ffc75955f5f2f083114897e9d23d88cac3bd30773697457736c72d6c688d6; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 18bba44c8e0201ee795556406cc28bda5786bc8e1b720a3a6bb054717f7601c4.

sega-adjustments.note: MAIN MENU: the right flipper button steps DIAG, AUD, ADJ, RESET, QUIT and HELP and wraps; the manual's PRNT icon is absent. ADJ > SEGA, stepped with Start, ends at Adjustment 43 GAME ID and wraps to 1 (Adjustment 2 has two pages), with no printer adjustment. No 37-44 transition. Raw scenario SHA256 63c1de9254035052a777a33a4367f7a7d270e25b4ea87bb7e2ab812624e20386; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 ab4301ebbe345ad6a35902574ead59719b5ab85b2af292fbc0218dd5167f952c.

switch-test.note: SWITCH TEST: every public address 1-64 and 81-88 held 0.45 s, then 0.3 s snapshots for the slow-debounce addresses 32, 44, 45, 46 and 60-62, whose names appear only after 0.6-1.2 s. The display can lag one address; readings cite only frames whose watched levels show the read address alone. Direct writes to 63/64 read back 0 (the flipper column overwrites them); 82 and 84 read back as 64 and 63. Raw scenario SHA256 5f4f395763d1a1d7fb587b84485b6366e289eae2f3f0f080a7da0c432f88b1fd; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 e2566ca44fb0bd581462542533fc2fa4ce22603f4b04c4e789b3cfc5680ddb3c.
